empirical_dependency.title: Individual Characteristics vs. Experience: An Experimental Study on Cooperation in Prisoner's Dilemma
empirical_dependency.extent_read: All 13 PDF pages including methods, results, discussion, ethics/funding, and references. Printed Table 6 at page 11 visually checked.
empirical_dependency.claim_extent: Its own recruitment, task, payoff, measure, design, printed regression coefficients and standard errors, unconditional-cooperation decision rates, and limitations. No independent assertion of studies surveyed in its introduction or supplementary-only test tables.
empirical_dependency.population: Undergraduate volunteers at Universitat Jaume I, Spain, December 2014; 178 first-session participants, 162 second-session participants, 81 pairs; ten decisions per participant per task.
empirical_dependency.limitations: Traits not randomly manipulated; random pairing within trait-defined groups; fixed one-shot then repeated task order; expectations and history offer rival explanations; no TSR construct measured; no raw-data reanalysis or replication; supplement not acquired or represented as read.

local_formal_results.scope: Exact matrix dominance, unique independent mixed equilibrium, mutual utility improvement, and unchanged dominance for optimistic beliefs
Finite expected-value comparison completeness, transitivity, independence, continuity, affine invariance, and explicitly editorial structural-value example
